name: CANFIELD RES (TOM & JUDY)
address: 20728 SE IRON HORSE LANE, BEND, OR 97702

fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the street.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the residence without obstruction.
• Trim any landscaping along the driveway edges that narrows the usable width for emergency vehicles.
• Mark or identify the single access point clearly so arriving responders can locate it without delay.
• Keep the walkway clear to allow responders to move quickly between the front driveway and the patio area on foot.
• Identify and communicate any secondary foot access route around the sides of the residence to local fire and EMS crews in advance.
• Keep side access points unlocked and free of obstacles so responders are not forced to force entry or detour around the structure.
• Trim landscaping along the sides of the residence to allow responders to move along the exterior walls without obstruction.
• Mark any changes in grade or surface around the water feature so responders moving across the lawn at night are not at risk of a fall.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs that are growing close to the house to create open space between the plants and the structure.
• Thin scattered shrubs near the house to reduce the amount of burnable material directly around it.
• Mow or cut grass around the house and any outbuildings to keep it short and reduce the amount of ground-level material that can carry fire.
• Keep grass mowed short along the driveway to reduce burnable material on both sides of the access route.
• Remove any shrubs or overgrown grass that could block or narrow the driveway and slow emergency vehicle entry.
• Keep the driveway clear of any branches, debris, or vegetation that hangs low over the roadway.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is easy to identify quickly from the road during an emergency.
• Maintain open, mowed areas between shrub groupings to break up the connection between plants and reduce the chance fire can move between them.
